answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks via quadratic stake burning. Legitimate agents cluster in an oasis of trusted interactions, while an attacker attempting to flood the network with n identities must bridge an expanding canyon of zero-knowledge stake proofs. The system imposes a superlinear burn cost scaling as O(n^2), turning any sybil swarm into an economic ocean of burned collateral that renders identity fabrication mathematically unviable.
